-- Typed request and runner/service state. JSON is confined to validation and output.
pub type StepDefinition = StepDefinition {
  id: String,
  needs: List(String),
  amount: Int,
  failures: Int
}

pub type Checkpoint = AfterBegin | AfterCall

pub type Command
  = Start(String)
  | Tick(Option(Checkpoint))
  | Advance(Int)
  | Observe
  | Crash
  | Restart
  | Cancel(String)

pub type Workflow = Workflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(Command),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int
}

pub type StepStatus = Pending | Running | Succeeded | StepFailed | Blocked | StepCancelled deriving (Eq)
pub type RunStatus = Active | Completed | RunFailed | Failing | Cancelling | RunCancelled deriving (Eq)

-- A running step holds exactly one durable lease; every other step holds none.
pub type Lease = Lease { worker: String, ticket: Int, expires: Int } deriving (Eq)

pub type StepState = StepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int,
  lease: Option(Lease)
}

pub type RunState = RunState {
  id: String,
  status: RunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(StepState)
}

-- The idempotency key stays structured; its components are never concatenated.
pub type ActionKey = ActionKey { run_id: String, step_id: String }

pub type CallKind = ExecuteKind | LookupKind deriving (Eq)
pub type Outcome = Applied | Replayed | Transient | Found | Missing deriving (Eq)

-- The audit records which acquisition issued a call; the logical key is separate.
pub type ServiceCall = ServiceCall {
  worker: String,
  ticket: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  key: ActionKey,
  attempt: Int,
  outcome: Outcome
}
pub type Effect = Effect { key: ActionKey, amount: Int }
pub type MockService = MockService { calls: List(ServiceCall), effects: List(Effect) }

-- One atomic service interaction: the audited service plus its committed outcome.
pub type Response = Response { service: MockService, outcome: Outcome }

pub type Snapshot = Snapshot { now: Int, up: Bool, runs: List(RunState) }
pub type Simulator = Simulator {
  now: Int,
  up: Bool,
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  observations: List(Snapshot)
}

pub type Action = Action { run: RunState, step: StepState, definition: StepDefinition }

-- Leased mode: several workers, expiring leases, and split call/deliver phases.
pub type LCommand
  = LStart(String)
  | LAdvance(Int)
  | LObserve
  | LCrash(String)
  | LRestart(String)
  | LClaim(String)
  | LRenew(String, Int)
  | LCall(String, Int)
  | LDeliver(Int)
  | LCancel(String)

pub type Leased = Leased {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(LCommand),
  workers: List(String),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int,
  lease_duration: Int
}

pub type Worker = Worker { id: String, up: Bool }

-- Ticket metadata, including a produced but undelivered response, is transport
-- state: it outlives worker crashes and lease expiry.
pub type TicketState = TicketState {
  id: Int,
  worker: String,
  run_id: String,
  step_id: String,
  attempt: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  response: Option(Outcome),
  delivered: Bool
}

pub type LSnapshot = LSnapshot { now: Int, workers: List(Worker), runs: List(RunState) }

pub type CmdResult
  = ResNull
  | ResTicket(Option(Int))
  | ResRenewed(Bool)
  | ResCommitted(Bool)
  | ResReceipt(CallKind, Outcome)
  | ResStale
  | ResSnapshot(LSnapshot)

pub type World = World {
  now: Int,
  workers: List(Worker),
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  tickets: List(TicketState),
  next_ticket: Int,
  results: List(CmdResult)
}

pub type Session = LegacySession(Simulator) | LeasedSession(World)

pub fn time_limit() : Int = 2147483647

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)
import Runner (snapshot)

fn step_status(status : StepStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Pending => "pending"
    Running => "running"
    Succeeded => "succeeded"
    StepFailed => "failed"
    Blocked => "blocked"
    StepCancelled => "cancelled"

fn run_status(status : RunStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Active => "active"
    Completed => "succeeded"
    RunFailed => "failed"
    Failing => "failing"
    Cancelling => "cancelling"
    RunCancelled => "cancelled"

fn step_json(step : StepState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(step.id)), ("status", JStr(step_status(step.status))),
    ("attempts", JInt(step.attempts)), ("ready_at", JInt(step.ready_at))])

fn run_json(run : RunState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(run.id)), ("status", JStr(run_status(run.status))),
    ("cancel_requested", JBool(run.cancel_requested)), ("steps", JArr(map(step_json, run.steps)))])

fn snapshot_fields(state : Snapshot) : List((String, Json)) =
  [("now", JInt(state.now)), ("up", JBool(state.up)), ("runs", JArr(map(run_json, state.runs)))]

fn snapshot_json(state : Snapshot) : Json = JObj(snapshot_fields(state))

fn key_json(key : ActionKey) : Json = JArr([JStr(key.run_id), JStr(key.step_id)])

fn call_kind(kind : CallKind) : String =
  match kind of
    ExecuteKind => "execute"
    LookupKind => "lookup"

fn call_outcome(outcome : Outcome) : String =
  match outcome of
    Applied => "applied"
    Replayed => "replayed"
    Transient => "transient"
    Found => "found"
    Missing => "missing"

fn call_json(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  JObj([("kind", JStr(call_kind(call.kind))), ("key", key_json(call.key)),
    ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call_outcome(call.outcome)))])

fn effect_json(entry : Effect) : Json =
  JObj([("key", key_json(entry.key)), ("amount", JInt(entry.amount))])

-- Leased mode adds worker availability, leases and per-command values.
fn lease_json(lease : Option(Lease)) : Json =
  match lease of
    None => JNull
    Some(held) => JObj([("worker", JStr(held.worker)), ("ticket", JInt(held.ticket)),
      ("expires", JInt(held.expires))])

fn leased_step_json(step : StepState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(step.id)), ("status", JStr(step_status(step.status))),
    ("attempts", JInt(step.attempts)), ("ready_at", JInt(step.ready_at)), ("lease", lease_json(step.lease))])

fn leased_run_json(run : RunState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(run.id)), ("status", JStr(run_status(run.status))),
    ("cancel_requested", JBool(run.cancel_requested)), ("steps", JArr(map(leased_step_json, run.steps)))])

fn worker_json(worker : Worker) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(worker.id)), ("up", JBool(worker.up))])

fn leased_snapshot_fields(state : LSnapshot) : List((String, Json)) =
  [("now", JInt(state.now)), ("workers", JArr(map(worker_json, state.workers))),
    ("runs", JArr(map(leased_run_json, state.runs)))]

fn leased_call_json(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  JObj([("worker", JStr(call.worker)), ("ticket", JInt(call.ticket)),
    ("kind", JStr(call_kind(call.kind))), ("key", key_json(call.key)),
    ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call_outcome(call.outcome)))])

fn ticket_json(ticket : Option(Int)) : Json =
  match ticket of
    Some(id) => JInt(id)
    None => JNull

fn command_json(value : CmdResult) : Json =
  match value of
    ResNull => JNull
    ResTicket(ticket) => JObj([("ticket", ticket_json(ticket))])
    ResRenewed(renewed) => JObj([("renewed", JBool(renewed))])
    ResCommitted(committed) => JObj([("committed", JBool(committed))])
    ResReceipt(kind, outcome) =>
      JObj([("kind", JStr(call_kind(kind))), ("outcome", JStr(call_outcome(outcome)))])
    ResStale => JObj([("outcome", JStr("stale"))])
    ResSnapshot(state) => JObj(leased_snapshot_fields(state))

pub fn leased_result_json(world : World) : Json =
  let state = LSnapshot { now = world.now, workers = world.workers, runs = world.runs }
  let final_fields = append(leased_snapshot_fields(state),
    [("calls", JArr(map(leased_call_json, world.service.calls))),
      ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, world.service.effects)))])
  JObj([("results", JArr(map(command_json, world.results))), ("final", JObj(final_fields))])

pub fn result_json(sim : Simulator) : Json =
  let final_fields = append(snapshot_fields(snapshot(sim)),
    [("calls", JArr(map(call_json, sim.service.calls))), ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, sim.service.effects)))])
  JObj([("observations", JArr(map(snapshot_json, sim.observations))), ("final", JObj(final_fields))])

pub fn response_json(result : Result(Session, String)) : Json =
  match result of
    Ok(LegacySession(sim)) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", result_json(sim))])
    Ok(LeasedSession(world)) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", leased_result_json(world))])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

-- Leased mode: the same shapes plus workers, lease duration and split commands.
fn parse_lcommand(raw : Json) : Result(LCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(id) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(id) else LClaim(id))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(id, ticket) else LCall(id, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_lcommands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_lcommand(x)?
      let commands = parse_lcommands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- A "workers" field selects leased mode; its absence keeps the previous contract.
pub fn is_leased(raw : Json) : Bool =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) => any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs)
    _ => false

pub fn parse_leased(raw : Json) : Result(Leased, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_lcommands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- Shapes and scalars are complete before the graph, and both precede execution.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Leased { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease })

fn cancel_run(sim : Simulator, run : RunState) : Simulator =
  if terminal(run) then sim
  else
    let steps = map(\(step) -> if step.status == Pending then StepState { ..step, status = StepCancelled } else step,
      run.steps)
    -- A running step stays uncertain until a tick reconciles it by lookup.
    let status = if any(\(step) -> step.status == Running, steps) then Cancelling else RunCancelled
    replace_run(sim, RunState { ..run, status = status, cancel_requested = true, steps = steps })

        Some(held) => held.ticket == ticket.id && world.now < held.expires

defs.name: do_claim
defs.source:
fn do_claim(world : World, spec : Leased, id : String) : Result(World, String) =
  match find_worker(world, id) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")
    Some(worker) =>
      if not(worker.up) then Err("WORKER_DOWN")
      elif busy(world, id) then Err("WORKER_BUSY")
      else
        match pick_work(world, spec) of
          -- Without eligible work no ticket identifier is consumed.
          None => emit(world, ResTicket(None))
          Some(found) => grant(world, spec, id, fst(found), snd(found))

defs.name: authorize
defs.source:
fn authorize(world : World, id : String, ticket : Int) : Result(TicketState, String) =
  match find_worker(world, id) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")
    Some(worker) =>
      if not(worker.up) then Err("WORKER_DOWN")
      else
        match find_ticket(world, ticket) of
          None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
          -- Ownership means the original acquirer, even after a reclaim.
          Some(record) => if record.worker == id then Ok(record) else Err("WRONG_WORKER")

    None => false

defs.name: deliverable
defs.source:
fn deliverable(world : World, record : TicketState) : Bool =
  match find_worker(world, record.worker) of
    None => false
    Some(worker) =>
      worker.up && not(record.delivered) && has_response(record) && fencing_valid(world, record)

defs.name: do_deliver
defs.source:
fn do_deliver(world : World, spec : Leased, ticket : Int) : Result(World, String) =
  match find_ticket(world, ticket) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(record) =>
      -- A response that is undelivered, current, live and reachable commits once.
      if not(deliverable(world, record)) then emit(world, ResCommitted(false))
      else
        match record.response of
          None => emit(world, ResCommitted(false))
          Some(outcome) =>
            let marked = update_ticket(world, ticket, TicketState { ..record, delivered = true })
            let committed = commit_response(marked, spec, record, outcome)?
            emit(committed, ResCommitted(true))

defs.name: do_cancel
apply_leased
defs.source:
fn apply_leased(world : World, spec : Leased, command : LCommand) : Result(World, String) =
  match command of
    LStart(id) =>
      if any(\(run) -> run.id == id, world.runs) then Err("DUPLICATE_RUN")
      else
        let run = RunState { id = id, status = Active, cancel_requested = false,
          steps = map(\(definition) -> StepState { id = definition.id, status = Pending, attempts = 0,
            ready_at = world.now, lease = None }, spec.steps) }
        emit(World { ..world, runs = append(world.runs, [run]) }, ResNull)
    LAdvance(by) =>
      -- Time belongs to the simulator and moves with every worker down.
      if world.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW")
      else emit(World { ..world, now = world.now + by }, ResNull)
    LObserve => emit(world, ResSnapshot(world_snapshot(world)))
    LCrash(id) =>
      match find_worker(world, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")
        Some(worker) =>
          if not(worker.up) then Err("WORKER_DOWN")
          -- Leases and transport messages outlive the worker holding them.
          else emit(replace_worker(world, Worker { ..worker, up = false }), ResNull)
    LRestart(id) =>
      match find_worker(world, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")
        Some(worker) =>
          if worker.up then Err("WORKER_UP")
          else emit(replace_worker(world, Worker { ..worker, up = true }), ResNull)
    LClaim(id) => do_claim(world, spec, id)
    LRenew(id, ticket) => do_renew(world, spec, id, ticket)
    LCall(id, ticket) => do_call(world, spec, id, ticket)
    LDeliver(ticket) => do_deliver(world, spec, ticket)
    LCancel(id) =>
      match find_run(world, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
        Some(run) => do_cancel(world, run)

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

defs.name: parse_checkpoint
parse_command
defs.source:
fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

validate_graph
parse_workflow
defs.source:
fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

defs.name: parse_lcommand
defs.source:
fn parse_lcommand(raw : Json) : Result(LCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(id) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(id) else LClaim(id))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(id, ticket) else LCall(id, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: parse_lcommands
defs.source:
fn parse_lcommands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_lcommand(x)?
      let commands = parse_lcommands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

defs.name: is_leased

  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) => any(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "workers", pairs)
    _ => false

defs.name: parse_leased
defs.source:
fn parse_leased(raw : Json) : Result(Leased, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_lcommands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- Shapes and scalars are complete before the graph, and both precede execution.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Leased { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease })

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Session, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  match request of
    JObj(fields) =>
      let input = get_field(fields, "input")
      if is_leased(input) then
        let spec = parse_leased(input)?
        let world = simulate_leased(spec)?
        Ok(LeasedSession(world))
      else
        let workflow = parse_workflow(input)?
        let sim = simulate(workflow)?
        Ok(LegacySession(sim))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
